notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 78-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.62, bnp 1212, creatinine 1.93, hemoglobin 12.5, platelets 236, sodium 138, wbc 8.1; vitals dbp 65-70, heart_rate 76-82, map 82-88, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 117-123, spo2 97-98, temp 36.8-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 32%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.92, hemoglobin 12.7, platelets 241, sodium 138, wbc 8.7; vitals dbp 66-70, heart_rate 77-82, map 84-88, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 118-124, spo2 97-99, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 78-year-old female, length of stay 5 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
